name: agentic-workflow-setup
description: Intent-routed DEFINE, PLAN, BUILD, VERIFY, and lean-context skills with measurable local evaluation.

interface.longDescription: Define product intent, plan one module stage, implement bounded slices, author independent risk-based tests, debug concrete failures, and reduce context cost with measurable workflow evidence.
defaultPrompt: Turn my rough product idea into a release-ready module specification.
Plan one stage of this module from its accepted specification.
Implement this accepted Task Packet without crossing its module boundary.
Diagnose this reproducible failure using bounded code evidence.
